evals.name: prompt-caching-three-docsets
evals.prompt: I want everything the Claude, OpenAI and OpenRouter docs say about prompt caching pulled out into one reference file I can load instead of the three docsets. The exports are at ~/.claude/skills/web-text-mirror/text-mirror/docs.claude.com.llms, platform.openai.com.llms and openrouter.ai.llms. Include the related vocabulary (cache_control, breakpoints, TTL, cache hits/misses, pricing fields) and keep it small enough to fit in a prompt. Write it to the scratchpad, don't index anything.
evals.expected_output: A <slug>.llms/ directory with llms.txt, llms-full.txt, llms-small.txt, llms-facts.txt, llms-vocabulary.txt, concept-graph.json, manifest.json; a lexicon of 12+ terms with relations; units from at least two hosts; every line ends in a URL; a report with per-round unit counts, precision sample and question-bank scores.

assertions.name: pack directory has all six llms-family files
assertions.check: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, llms-small.txt, llms-facts.txt, llms-vocabulary.txt, concept-graph.json all exist in the output dir

assertions.name: every unit line is source-anchored
assertions.check: every line starting with '- [' in llms-full.txt and llms-facts.txt contains ' — http' or ' — file://'

assertions.name: lexicon has 12+ terms with at least 4 distinct relations
assertions.check: lexicon.json terms length >= 12 and distinct relation values >= 4

assertions.name: contrast-term pages did not flood the pack
assertions.check: units whose only matched term is a contrast/related term are < 10% of kept units (check units.jsonl keywords vs concept-graph relations)

assertions.name: report includes per-round counts and verification scores
assertions.check: the final report mentions round counts (r0→rN) and at least a precision sample and a question-bank score

evals.name: indexing-across-database-docsets-discovery
evals.prompt: abstract 'indexing' out of every database-related docset we have on the hub (mongodb export, and whichever llms-full mirrors are about databases — prisma, drizzle, nile etc). I care about index types, how the planner uses them, covered queries, selectivity, and the failure modes (unused/bloated indexes, collection scans). exclude the llms.txt 'index' sense. don't persist to the hub.
evals.expected_output: Scope discovered and listed before scanning (mongodb.com.llms facts + matching llms-full mirror files with --base-url where needed); excludes for 'llms.txt index'/'index.html'; lexicon with hyponyms (B-tree, compound, partial, TTL…), measures (selectivity), problems (COLLSCAN, bloat), contrast (full scan); a pack in the scratchpad; a report naming zero-hit terms and which vendor contributed what.

assertions.name: scope listed before scanning
assertions.check: the transcript shows the resolved file list (with hosts) before the multi-round harvest

assertions.name: excludes cover the llms.txt index sense
assertions.check: lexicon.json exclude contains a phrase matching 'llms.txt index' or 'index.html'

assertions.name: lexicon includes hyponym, measure, problem and contrast terms
assertions.check: lexicon.json relation values include hyponym, measure, problem and contrast

assertions.name: at least two vendors contribute units
assertions.check: manifest.json sources has >= 2 hosts with > 0 units

assertions.name: no hub writes
assertions.check: no docset_indexer index / hub_concept_queue calls; output dir is under the scratchpad

assertions.name: zero-hit terms reported
assertions.check: the report lists zero-hit lexicon terms or states there were none

evals.name: single-textbook-owned-material
evals.prompt: Here's a converted anatomy textbook chapter at /tmp/lca-eval/anatomy-ch12.md (my own scan, markdown with headings). Pull out everything about the heart — chambers, valves, conduction, cardiac cycle, blood supply, the diseases — into a compact study reference. Use longer quotes since it's my material, about 6k tokens for the short version.
evals.expected_output: Lexicon built from anatomical vocabulary (cardiac, myocardium, atrium, ventricle, SA node, systole/diastole, arrhythmia…) with excludes for figurative senses; harvest with --context 1 and --rights quote; small file ≈6k tokens; structure/mechanism/measures/problems facets populated; file:// anchors to headings; a question bank probed.

assertions.name: rights quote and context used
assertions.check: manifest rights == 'quote' and the harvest command used --context 1

assertions.name: anatomical synonyms in lexicon
assertions.check: lexicon includes cardiac and at least three part terms (atrium/ventricle/myocardium/valve/node)

assertions.name: structure and problems facets populated
assertions.check: manifest facets has structure >= 5 and problems >= 3

assertions.name: anchors point to headings in the file
assertions.check: unit lines end in file://…anatomy-ch12.md#<slug> with non-empty slugs for >= 80% of lines

assertions.name: question bank probed
assertions.check: bank.jsonl exists and probe output (or agent test) is reported
